examples.title: Contador animado

docs: Adapted from Arc UI (MIT). The value reel is number-roll: transform and opacity only, with the integer and the fraction in separate nodes. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
